summary: Configured node1 to require passwords of at least 12 characters using at least three character classes. Verified enforcement before and after reboot.
actions_performed: Verified pam_pwquality enforcement through system-auth and password-auth.
Confirmed a compliant password passes while passwords violating either requirement fail.
Safely restarted node1 and verified policy persistence, system health, and SSH recovery.

evidence.requirement: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and use at least three character classes.
evidence.summary: The persistent policy contains minlen=12 and minclass=3. Direct pwscore tests accepted a compliant password and rejected passwords that were too short or used only two character classes.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence.
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline used boot ID e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1; reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to a1ca0cf5-9eb5-44e8-936a-6457c827851c. The system returned to running state, SSH recovered, and both policy settings and enforcement tests remained intact.
